affected_content: const next = url.searchParams.get('next'); response.writeHead(302, { Location: next });
description: The login completion route redirects to a user-controlled next URL without same-origin validation or an allowlist. Attackers could use the trusted app domain in phishing or auth-flow exploit chains.
evidence: Demo unknown issue: /api/login/complete reads next from the query string and redirects directly to that value.
safe_rewrite: Only allow relative same-origin paths or validate redirect targets against an explicit allowlist before redirecting. Fall back to a safe default path when validation fails.
title: Open redirect risk in post-login redirect helper
